title: hq.json, schema 1
description: The manifest a project declares itself to HomeQuarters with (docs/standards/manifest.md). Paths are from the repo root unless they start with / or ~/.

schemaVersion.description: The defaults epoch, a whole number from 1.

name.description: The project's name, used in the cache path, titles and export file names.

home.description: The file Home opens on; default README.md.

groups.description: The groups file the file tree narrows to.

stages.description: The stages in order; default inbox, next, parked.

earlier.description: The one-line file of earlier items.

dir.description: The folder of dated decision files.

earlier.description: The one-line file of earlier decisions.

tests.description: Turns on the Testing page (docs/standards/pipeline.md, sets.md).

headers.description: Globs of the tests whose headers hq check reads.

stores.description: Which folders under the cache HQ reads.

info.description: The status line's project-info file: true for .git/project-info.json, or an object naming the file.

deploy.description: Deploy providers; HQ never reads inside with.

delivery.description: What the Delivery page counts and where it reads GitHub's runs.

tz.description: An IANA time zone, such as America/New_York.

dailyAt.description: When the project's daily run takes its copy of the figures, as hh:mm in tz, such as 07:07. hq dora writes a missed day's copy as of this time on that day; without it, as of the day's end.

blindSpots.description: From 0.3.4: what the project's figures cannot see, listed on Delivery under Not counted.

countingChanges.description: The project's notes on the days its figures started being counted another way, shown on Delivery. A note naming a decision file shows while that file is in the decisions folder; hq check reports one whose file is missing.

decision.description: A file name in the decisions folder.

mark.description: From 0.3.2: a short label Delivery's deploys chart draws on this note's day, such as "Laptop CI from here".

since.description: From 0.3.3: which of Delivery's dates this note gives: the day the gate moved to the Laptop ("Laptop since" beside gate time), or the day redeploys of a tree already live started being skipped ("skipped since" in Method). One note each.

demo.description: The demo setting's file for filming.

link.description: The file hq serve writes {"url","pid"} to as it starts, so the project's app can link to HQ; removed when it stops.
